newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank says hopes for lower bond yields.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank says hopes for lower bond yields.

text.p: Swedish Riksbank Governor Urban Backstrom said on Thursday he hoped long Swedish bond yields would continue to fall.
"It is a problem to have a spread of 120 to 130 basis points against (long) German bond yields, but there is scope for an improvement in confidence," Backstrom told reporters.

"I hope long bond yields have not bottomed out for the time. I hope we can build such confidence that long bond yields will come down to a good European level. Then there is scope for lower long bond yields," Backstrom said.
